title: Clip a wafer onto an e-beam evaporator's sample plate and load it face down
instruction: Mount the wafer on the sample plate for e-beam evaporation, load it into the load lock and close the door.
context: The evaporator coats from below, so the wafer hangs face down: it must be centred and held by clips that bite its round edge, enough of them, with screws that fit, or it falls or jams the transfer.
reset_notes: One fixed layout; nothing is consumed. Clips start parked open with loose screws; the load lock door starts open.
